description: Directly update exact content fields without a generation run or credit spend. Pass body for the full replacement copy/story. IDs: content_id is the CONTENT id — in autowhisper_feed output that is the `content: <type> #<id>` part of a row, NOT the leading `feed_item #<id>` (that one belongs to autowhisper_action).

autowhisper_token.description: Optional: your AutoWhisper API token, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

content_id.description: The CONTENT id from the feed row's `content: <type> #<id>` — not the feed_item id.

content_type.description: Content type in snake_case, as printed in the feed row's `content:` part.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the user's CURRENT workspace. The target item must live in that workspace — an id from another workspace will not be found.

name: autowhisper_edit_content
